business_summary: Mobile-health Network Solutions, an investment holding company, provides telehealth solutions primarily in Singapore. The company operates in two segments: Telemedicine and Other Services and Sale of Medicine and Medical Devices. It offers MaNaDr platform, a 360-degree healthcare ecosystem, which connects users and service providers through the range of healthcare services and product offerings that can be accessed through the mobile application and website, as well as Internet search engines. The company also provides a suite of medical-related and other services, including teleconsultations and health check-up services, vaccinations, skin and aesthetics services, and other services. In addition, it offers healthcare and wellness products through its online e-commerce platform; wholesale distribution of pharmaceutical products to clinics through MaNaPharma platform; and MaNaCare, a platform that provides a range of corporate healthcare and wellness services, including GP, specialist and allied healthcare panel services, tele-consultation services, in-person clinics, on-site health screening, and online marketplace, as well as wellness programs to corporate customers. Further, the company develops IT systems on mobile phone and web portals; operates pharmacies, clinics, and drug stores; and offers beauty and other personal care services, as well as other general medical services. Additionally, it offers health supplements, skincare, nutrition products and medical devices wellness, personal care; health screening packages; and online services such as medical screenings and procedures, such as serology and swab tests. The company was founded in 2009 and is headquartered in Singapore.
business_summary_ko: 투자 지주 회사인 Mobile-health Network Solutions는 주로 싱가포르에서 원격 의료 솔루션을 제공합니다. 이 회사는 원격 의료 및 기타 서비스와 의약품 및 의료 기기 판매라는 두 가지 부문으로 운영됩니다. 모바일 애플리케이션과 웹사이트는 물론 인터넷 검색 엔진을 통해 접근할 수 있는 다양한 의료 서비스와 제품 제공을 통해 사용자와 서비스 제공자를 연결하는 360도 의료 생태계인 MaNaDr 플랫폼을 제공합니다. 또한 이 회사는 원격 상담, 건강 검진 서비스, 예방 접종, 피부 및 미용 서비스, 기타 서비스를 포함한 일련의 의료 관련 및 기타 서비스를 제공합니다. 또한 온라인 전자상거래 플랫폼을 통해 의료 및 웰니스 제품을 제공합니다.
